answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13038 Country: India Title: Please let me know whether we have to recite surah fatiha behind an imam in Zohr and Asr salah. Question: Please let me know whether we have to recite surah fatiha behind an imam in Zohr and Asr salah. Answer ID: 13038 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 821/821=M/1430) Muqtadi should not recite the Quran not even Surah Fatihah behind an imam, whether the salah is silent like Zuhr and Asr or it loud: والم ؤ تم لا یقرء مطلقا ولا الفاتحۃ في السریۃ اتفاقاً (درمختار ( Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
